title: Core Models
requirements: Implement DiaryEntry struct (id: UUID, startedAt: Date, durationSeconds: Double, audioPath: String, transcriptPath: String, source: TranscriptSource, createdAt: Date, updatedAt: Date) as Hashable, Codable, Sendable
Implement Transcript struct (text: String, confidence: Double?, source: TranscriptSource, isFinal: Bool) as Hashable, Codable, Sendable
Implement TranscriptSource enum (speech, whisper, none) as String, Codable, Sendable
Implement TranscriptUpdate enum (partial(String), final(Transcript), failed(String)) as Sendable
acceptance_criteria: All types compile as Codable and Sendable
DiaryEntry round-trips through JSON encoding/decoding with no data loss
TranscriptSource encodes as lowercase string values
